asset_heavy.reason: Makes grafts and spinal implants in a processing facility; no fleets or networks, moderately capital-light medical device model.

big_ticket.reason: Grafts and implants are used per surgery; each sale is modest and repeated, not large infrequent purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Orthobiologic grafts and spinal implants are used in medically needed surgeries, though some elective procedures can be deferred.

large_customers.reason: Sells to hospitals, surgeons and distributors, not mainly large enterprises or government agencies.

notes: Customers are mostly hospitals and surgeons; buyer classification for large customers is somewhat uncertain.

offers_products.reason: Sells orthobiologic grafts such as OsteoFactor Pro and Trivium, plus spinal implant systems.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from products; tissue processing supports its own grafts rather than services sold to others.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured biologic grafts and spinal implants, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Surgeons and hospitals repeatedly reorder single-use grafts and implants for ongoing procedures.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Surgeons and hospitals choose the grafts and implants; patients do not buy directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells grafts and spinal implants to hospitals, surgeons and distributors who choose and receive them.
